description: Identity, values, self-concept, emotional life, psychological patterns, how the person thinks, copes, regulates, and grows. Who they are when no one is watching.
Career, projects, goals, plans, skills, creative work, learning-in-service-of-doing. What the person is building and working toward.
Connections, family, friends, romantic life, social needs, relational patterns and history. How the person relates to other people.
Health, fitness, energy, nutrition, sleep, physical state, limitations, embodied experience. What the body enables and constrains.
